latest_news.headline: Iran releases 10 oil tankers through Strait of Hormuz as 'present' for talks
latest_news.text: Trump reveals Iran released 10 Pakistani-flagged oil tankers through Hormuz as a goodwill gesture. US confirms ship attacks have stopped since Mar 19. But US says at least a dozen mines still in passageway.

latest_news.headline: Trump: Taking Iran's oil is 'an option' - compares to Venezuela deal
latest_news.text: Trump at Cabinet meeting: taking control of Iran's oil is 'an option', compares to Venezuela model. Also says US doesn't know if mines still in Hormuz but 'blew up all their mine droppers'.

latest_news.headline: Iran carries out 8th missile wave at Israel amid intensifying US-Israeli strikes
latest_news.text: Iran launched its 8th wave of missiles at Israel on Thursday. Al Jazeera correspondent in Tehran reports US-Israeli attacks 'increasing in number and intensity'. Israel announced extensive strikes on central Isfahan.

latest_news.headline: Iran FM Araghchi: Tehran will continue 'resistance', will not negotiate
latest_news.text: Iran Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran will continue its 'resistance' and does not intend to negotiate, despite Trump claims that talks are happening.

latest_news.headline: Iran parliament drafts law to collect tolls from ships transiting Strait of Hormuz
latest_news.text: Iranian parliament preparing draft law mandating toll collection from ships transiting Strait of Hormuz, treating the waterway as a standard transit corridor with fees in Chinese yuan.

outlook: CRITICAL (Day 27, Hour 18 UTC). Mixed signals: Iran's Hormuz commander Tangsiri killed (escalation) but 10 tankers released (de-escalation). Iran formally rejected US 15-point plan with 5-point counterproposal — both sides posturing ahead of Islamabad talks this weekend. Israel accelerates strikes anticipating diplomatic window may close. Russia-Ukraine: spring offensive intensifies as Iran war diverts US attention, Leningrad refinery hit. Ground ops signal: 82nd Airborne + Marines deployed to Gulf. Window for diplomacy exists but narrowing fast.
de_escalation_watch: DE-ESCALATION WATCH (Day 27, Hour 18 UTC). MIXED BUT TILTING TOWARD DE-ESCALATION. Iran released 10 tankers, ship attacks halted 7 days. Iran submitted counterproposal (5-point) — rejection but WITH conditions = negotiating posture. Araghchi + Ghalibaf reportedly off Pakistan kill list for Islamabad talks. However: Tangsiri assassination is a major escalation, 8th missile wave at Israel, Trump mixed messaging ('begging' + 'unleash hell'). Islamabad talks this weekend = critical inflection point. If they fail, expect rapid escalation.
